name: Quick Pill 5.5.8
changelog: Feature: Hovering a notification banner now jumps straight into the Notifications module instead of the default tab.
Feature: Notifications can be swiped upwards to dismiss them - both the banner and the rows in the notification centre - with a little dust puff on the way out.
Feature: New global shortcut Alt+Shift+D ('Dismiss Notification') flicks the newest notification away without touching the mouse.
Feature: Clicking a notification now opens its target - the deep link of the notification when it has one, otherwise the app that produced it (an already running window is activated first).
Polish: The notification model keeps the optional deep link of a notification so web and mail notifications can open the right page.
